# HAPI attribution

The Android UI source in `android-native/` was carried forward from the prior `windows-client` repository at commit `f8350e400cf6e7420d8283e03eb6efa37104ca79`. Its light theme is identified in source as adapted from [tiann/hapi](https://github.com/tiann/hapi) Android UI. HAPI is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License version 3. The license text bundled here is from [HAPI's LICENSE](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/blob/main/LICENSE).

This new module changes the package identity, debug signing, version, server placeholder, and Android update path while retaining the existing UI baseline. See the commit history for subsequent modifications. The JetBrains Mono font has its separate SIL Open Font License in the Android assets.
